description: This file is a Perl module implementing the Git::SVN package. It contains a comprehensive set of functions and methods for interfacing between Git and Subversion repositories, including remote management, revisions, properties, and synchronization. It is a core source file providing key functionality for the git-svn interoperability layer.

classes.name: Git::SVN
classes.description: The main class encapsulating the functionality for managing git-svn interactions, including remote repo configuration, revision mapping, and synchronization

classes.name: Git::SVN
classes.description: Main class encapsulating SVN repository interaction, revision mapping, and configuration management.

methods.name: resolve_local_globs
methods.description: Resolves local glob patterns to specific refs, updating fetch mappings accordingly.

methods.name: parse_revision_argument
methods.description: Parses revision arguments, supporting various formats like 'BASE:HEAD', numeric revisions, etc.

methods.name: fetch_all
methods.description: Fetches all remote SVN revisions based on configured remotes and fetches them for specified repositories.

methods.name: read_all_remotes
methods.description: Reads and parses all remote repository configurations for svn-remote sections.

methods.name: init_vars
methods.description: Initializes internal variables related to garbage collection and repack parameters.

methods.name: verify_remotes_sanity
methods.description: Verifies the sanity of remote configurations to prevent ambiguous tracking.

methods.name: find_existing_remote
methods.description: Finds an existing remote configuration for a given URL if any.

methods.name: init_remote_config
methods.description: Initializes remote configuration for a given URL, potentially reusing existing remote entries.

methods.name: find_by_url
methods.description: Looks up a remote repository by its URL, optionally matching repos root and path.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Constructs a new Git::SVN object with remote URL and other parameters.

methods.name: find_ref
methods.description: Finds remote ref configuration matching a specified ref ID.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new Git::SVN object, possibly resolving by ref name.

methods.name: refname
methods.description: Returns a sanitized and encoded version of the reference name.

methods.name: desanitize_refname
methods.description: Decodes a sanitized refname back to its original form.

methods.name: svm_uuid
methods.description: Retrieves the SVM UUID for the object, caching it if necessary.

methods.name: svm
methods.description: Retrieves or sets SVM properties associated with the repository.

methods.name: _set_svm_vars
methods.description: Reads and sets SVM properties for the repository if applicable.

methods.name: svnsync
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the svnsync configuration for the repository.

methods.name: ra_uuid
methods.description: Gets the repository UUID, with caching.

methods.name: _set_repos_root
methods.description: Stores repository root information in config.

methods.name: repos_root
methods.description: Retrieves repository root URL for the object.

methods.name: ra
methods.description: Returns a new SVN::Ra object for the repository, initializing SVM and other properties as needed.

methods.name: prop_walk
methods.description: Recursively traverses SVN directory properties, invoking a callback for relevant directories.

methods.name: last_rev
methods.description: Returns the latest SVN revision number.

methods.name: last_commit
methods.description: Returns the latest commit SHA1.

methods.name: last_rev_commit
methods.description: Returns a tuple of the latest revision number and commit SHA1, caching results.

methods.name: get_fetch_range
methods.description: Calculates and returns the range of revisions to fetch.

methods.name: svn_dir
methods.description: Returns SVN directory path in the git directory structure.

methods.name: tmp_config
methods.description: Temporarily sets and manages SVN configuration for commands executed within.

methods.name: tmp_index_do
methods.description: Runs a callback with a temporary GIT_INDEX_FILE environment variable set.

methods.name: assert_index_clean
methods.description: Ensures the index matches the specified commit.

methods.name: get_commit_parents
methods.description: Retrieves the parent commits for a given log entry, considering injected parents for branch management.

methods.name: rewrite_root
methods.description: Returns or sets a rewrite URL for repository root.

methods.name: rewrite_uuid
methods.description: Returns or sets a rewrite UUID for the repository.

methods.name: metadata_url
methods.description: Computes the URL for repository metadata, considering rewrite settings.

methods.name: full_url
methods.description: Returns the full URL of the repository.

methods.name: full_pushurl
methods.description: Returns the push URL for the repository, if configured.

methods.name: set_commit_header_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for commit author and date information.

methods.name: restore_commit_header_env
methods.description: Restores environment variables set for commit headers.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Runs garbage collection in git.

methods.name: do_git_commit
methods.description: Performs a git commit based on SVN log data, updating revision mappings.

methods.name: match_paths
methods.description: Checks if the given paths or path regex match the current object.

methods.name: find_parent_branch
methods.description: Finds a parent branch using SVN log data and branch copying info.

methods.name: do_fetch
methods.description: Fetches SVN revisions and updates git with commit info.

methods.name: mkemptydirs
methods.description: Creates empty directories as recorded in logs and filesystem states.

methods.name: get_untracked
methods.description: Returns a list of untracked items in the current SVN directory.

methods.name: parse_svn_date
methods.description: Parses SVN date strings into local or UTC time formats compatible with git.

methods.name: other_gs
methods.description: Finds a neighboring git-svn object for a different URL.

methods.name: call_authors_prog
methods.description: Runs an external program to normalize author names and emails.

methods.name: check_author
methods.description: Validates and possibly transforms author information.

methods.name: find_extra_svk_parents
methods.description: Discovers additional parent commits based on svk:merge properties.

methods.name: lookup_svn_merge
methods.description: Looks up SVN mergeinfo to identify merged revisions.

methods.name: _rev_list
methods.description: Returns a list of revisions from a git rev-list invocation.

methods.name: check_cherry_pick2
methods.description: Checks for cherry-pick commits with no changes.

methods.name: has_no_changes
methods.description: Returns true if a commit has no changes compared to its parent.

methods.name: tie_for_persistent_memoization
methods.description: Sets up persistent memoization caches for SVN functions.

methods.name: unmemoize_svn_mergeinfo_functions
methods.description: Clears memoization for specific functions.

methods.name: clear_memoized_mergeinfo_caches
methods.description: Clears cache files for SVN mergeinfo functions.

methods.name: parents_exclude
methods.description: Excludes specific parents from revision list for merge detection.

methods.name: mergeinfo_changes
methods.description: Computes changes in svn:mergeinfo between revisions.

methods.name: find_extra_svn_parents
methods.description: Discovers additional SVN parent commits based on merge info.

methods.name: make_log_entry
methods.description: Creates a detailed log entry object for a revision, including author, message, and metadata.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Triggers SVN fetch for a revision range.

methods.name: set_tree_cb
methods.description: Callback for setting tree during a revision set operation.

methods.name: set_tree
methods.description: Sets a specific commit tree for the current object.

methods.name: rebuild_from_rev_db
methods.description: Rebuilds revision to commit mappings from a database file.

methods.name: rev_map_set
methods.description: Sets a revision ID to commit hash mapping, updating the revision database.

methods.name: mkfile
methods.description: Creates a new file at the specified path, including parent directories if needed.

methods.name: use_fsync
methods.description: Determines if fsync should be used, based on environment variables and test configuration.

methods.name: rev_map_set
methods.description: Sets a mapping from a revision number to a commit hash, updating the revision database and optionally updating the ref.

methods.name: rev_map_max
methods.description: Returns the highest revision number (or commit) in the revision map, rebuilding if necessary.

methods.name: rev_map_max_norebuild
methods.description: Returns the maximum revision (or commit) without rebuilding the map, reading from the revision map file.

methods.name: rev_map_get
methods.description: Retrieves the commit hash associated with a specific revision number from the revision map.

methods.name: _rev_map_get
methods.description: Internal method to perform a binary search in the revision map file for a revision number.

methods.name: find_rev_before
methods.description: Finds the first revision on or before a given revision, and returns associated commit if found.

methods.name: find_rev_after
methods.description: Finds the first revision on or after a given revision, and returns associated commit if found.

methods.name: _new
methods.description: Constructor for a Git::SVN object, initializing paths and references.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Getter and setter for the repository path, canonicalizing on set.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Getter and setter for the repository URL, canonicalizing on set.

methods.name: unlink_rev_db_symlink
methods.description: Removes a symbolic link to revision database if it exists.

methods.name: rev_db_path
methods.description: Computes the path to the revision database file for a specific UUID.

methods.name: map_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the revision map file, optionally for a specific UUID.

methods.name: uri_encode
methods.description: Percent-encodes special characters in a URL component.

methods.name: uri_decode
methods.description: Decodes percent-encoded URL components back to characters.

methods.name: remove_username
methods.description: Strips username information from a URL, leaving the base URL.
